instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements both Zigbee transmitter and receiver blocks. Zigbee is a wireless communication protocol that uses low-power digital radios to enable communication between devices at short ranges. The transmitter block will send data to the receiver block wirelessly, and the receiver block will receive the data and send it to the output.
Your module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a set of n input signals (in1, in2, ..., inn)
Outputs: a set of m output signals (out1, out2, ..., outm)
The module should also have the following parameters:

n: the number of input signals
m: the number of output signals
baud_rate: the rate of data transfer in bits per second
channel: the channel on which the Zigbee communication will take place
radio_power: the power level of the Zigbee radio

Your module should implement the following functionality:

The transmitter block should take the input data and modulate it using the Zigbee protocol before transmitting it wirelessly.
The receiver block should receive the data wirelessly, demodulate it using the Zigbee protocol, and then send it to the output.
To implement the Zigbee transmitter and receiver blocks, you should use Verilog code to define the modulation and demodulation processes. You should also use Verilog code to define the radio power, channel, and baud rate.
You should then use these functions to connect the inputs to the transmitter block, connect the transmitter block to the receiver block wirelessly, and connect the receiver block to the output signals.
